en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by gentle hills and forests. In the middle distance rises a large church with a tall Baroque-style tower topped by a cross, dominating clusters of gabled houses with steep roofs. Behind the church is a long, palace‑like building and more traditional townhouses. The foreground is filled with trees and rooftops, suggesting the scene is taken from an elevated vantage point. There is no visible text on the image.
